story.title: A family tradition, painted by hand
story.body: Olinda was born from our mother's hands — a ceramic painter in the tradition of Condeixa and Conímbriga. We grew up among brushes, paints and the fine strokes of this centuries-old craft. Today, mother and daughters bring that heritage together with the wish to create new pieces, made for each client.

about.title: The art of hand-painting, from mother to daughters
about.intro: Olinda is a family studio. It brings together a lifetime of painting ceramics in the tradition of Condeixa and Conímbriga with the wish to create custom pieces, made for each person and each occasion.

sections.title: The tradition
sections.body: Our mother spent years painting the ceramics of Condeixa and Conímbriga — those fine strokes, the floral motifs and the serene palette passed down through generations. It is that steady hand and that eye that live in every piece we make.

sections.title: Our take
sections.body: We don't just want to repeat the past. We love taking that heritage and creating new pieces: simpler, more personal, for everyday life and for the moments that stay with us.

sections.title: Made by hand, made for you
sections.body: Every piece is painted by hand, one by one. No two are alike — and that's what makes them yours. We work with you, from the first sketch to the finished piece.

faq.a: It depends on the piece and the quantity. Once we know your idea, we give you a clear estimate in the quote.
We make anything from a single piece to large sets for events. Talk to us about what you need.

faq.q: Can I send my own design?
faq.a: Yes! We love starting from your ideas. Send references, colours or sketches and we'll work from there.
We explain the care for each piece on delivery. Many are made for daily use; the more decorative ones need a little extra care.
